declared_conventions.geometry: unit S3 with q_ab=a^2 gamma_ab, Vol(S3,gamma)=2*pi^2, R[gamma]=6
declared_conventions.gravity_action: S_g=(16*pi*G)^(-1) integral dt d^3x N sqrt(q) (K_ab K^ab-K^2+R[q]), with K_ab=(2N)^(-1)(dot(q_ab)-D_a N_b-D_b N_a)
declared_conventions.linear_scalar_gauge_coordinate: h_ab^(S)=2*psi*gamma_ab+2*D_a D_b E; for xi_a=D_a L, declare delta_L E=L and use D_L^lin=sum_I L_I*Pi_E,I with {E_I,Pi_E,J}=delta_IJ
declared_conventions.scalar_action: S_phi=(1/2) integral dt d^3x N sqrt(q) ((n^mu partial_mu phi)^2-q^ab partial_a phi partial_b phi), with V(phi)=0
declared_conventions.units: G=1/(8*pi), hbar is absent because this is a classical exact audit
